# globchat

> A temporary, real-time chat web app. There are no accounts, no sign-up, and no message history — everything lives only in the browser tab and disappears when it closes.

globchat has two modes:

- **Global Chat** — one public room shared by everyone currently on the site, in plain text, real-time, with no persistence on the server.
- **Private Chat** — code-gated rooms (4-character codes) that are end-to-end encrypted: message text and file attachments are both encrypted in the browser (AES-GCM, key derived from the room code via PBKDF2) before anything leaves the device, so the server only ever sees ciphertext.

Files up to 50 MB can be shared in either mode. There is no database of users or messages; state exists only in memory/sessionStorage for the duration of the visit.

## Pages

- [Home / chat app](https://globchat.pages.dev/): The chat application itself — enter a display name to join the global room, or create/join a private encrypted room by code.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://globchat.pages.dev/terms.html): Usage terms, acceptable use, content and moderation policy, and privacy notes.
